items.title: ITC Q1 earnings hit by cigarette tax burden; FMCG, paper businesses offer support
items.description: ITC's June 2026 earnings fell due to higher cigarette taxes and disruptions. Resilient growth in the consumer segment cushioned the overall impact. Categories like dairy and snacks showed strong year-on-year gains. The paperboards and packaging business also saw a significant recovery. Analysts have reduced earnings estimates for upcoming fiscal years.

items.title: Nazara Tech Q1 Results: Co posts Rs 82.5 crore loss; Nitish Mittersain steps down as CEO
items.description: Nazara Technologies reported a net loss of Rs 82.47 crore for the first quarter. Revenue from operations declined 14 percent to Rs 428.77 crore in Q1 FY27. Nitish Mittersain will resign as CEO on September 1, 2026. Raymond Albaladejo Stauffer will succeed Mittersain as the new Chief Executive Officer. The company also revised acquisition terms for Bluetile Games and Bestplay Systems.

items.title: Bharti Airtel Q1 Results: Net profit surges 37% YoY to Rs 8,167 crore; ARPU rises to Rs 264
items.description: Bharti Airtel Q1 Results: Telecom major Bharti Airtel on Tuesday reported a consolidated net profit of Rs 8,167 crore for the April-June quarter of FY27, a more than 37% year-on-year increase from the Rs 5,948 crore net profit reported in the same period last year.

items.title: Nykaa Q1 Results: Net profit spikes 243% YoY to Rs 80 crore; revenue jumps 29%
items.description: Nykaa's quarterly profit saw a significant increase, more than tripling year-on-year.  Strong growth in the beauty business and fashion sales acceleration drove this profit rise.  The company's revenue from operations also increased by over twenty-nine percent.  Analysts expect continued strength across both beauty and fashion segments.  Improved conversion and customer acquisition fueled the fashion business's sharp acceleration.

items.title: Jindal Stainless Q1 net profit up 8%, price hikes offset cost surge
items.description: Jindal Stainless production dipped during the June quarter due to West Asia conflict disruptions.  However, price increases helped ease some of the cost pressures experienced.  Consolidated net profit rose nearly 8% while revenue increased by ten percent.  Sales volume dropped over 7%, impacted by fuel supply chain issues.  The company's net debt decreased, and its net debt-to-EBITDA ratio improved.

items.title: BSE Q1 Results: Profit soars 62% YoY to Rs 874 crore, revenue surges 63%
items.description: BSE Q1 Results: BSE Ltd reported a 62% year-on-year profit rise in the first quarter of FY27. Revenue from operations increased significantly, contributing to the strong financial performance. Investment income also saw a sharp increase during the quarter. Profit before tax grew by 66% compared to the previous year. Total expenses rose by 49% as various costs increased.

items.title: PNB Housing Q1 profit rises 4% as loan book grows 15%
items.description: PNB Housing Finance posted a 4.3% rise in June-quarter net profit as loan assets and AUM recorded double-digit growth. Net interest margin narrowed, while asset quality improved with lower gross NPAs despite higher operating expenses during the quarter.
